name: Storm sea
description: A heavy sea at night seen from a boat, ray-marched: the swell is the spectrum, each train of waves (the longest the bass) rising with its own part, the chop with the high notes; foam streaks the crests, the moon comes and goes behind the storm clouds and glitters on the water. On its rock a lighthouse turns on the music's clock, its two beams sweeping through the mist, across the water and over you.
